answer: Each new identity must lock a refundable stake for eight epochs and collect five established, non-kin attestations before unlock. Every attestor posts a smaller counter-bond. During the lock, any peer may challenge with evidence of shared keys, synchronized votes, or reused hardware proofs; a proven clone slashes that stake and the false attestors' bonds to the challenger. Withdrawals cannot be rushed, so mass cloning ties up capital and calendar time. Operators keep a prism report of overlapping attestations, a nebula queue of still-locked bonds, and a log of each whisper of a challenge.
